verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents an official BugSnag CLI that creates releases and builds on the dashboard and uploads files such as source maps and symbols to improve stack traces. Its documented scope is narrow, covering build and upload tasks, so it clearly delivers an official CLI but evidences little beyond that. Missing for 10: CLI commands for querying or triaging errors and projects, documented machine-readable output or agent-oriented usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
